page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a big data instance designed for high-capacity sequential storage architectures and distributed processing. Built on KVM virtualization using the x86_64 architecture, this server provides 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The platform is provisioned with 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an even 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM allocated per core.

A notable hardware specification of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is its bundled storage subsystem, which delivers 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) capacity. Network interfaces are configured with a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the system operates without dedicated GPU acceleration. The deployment of dense mechanical disks supplies substantial local volume for large data sets, though rotational storage delivers lower random input and output speeds compared to solid-state alternatives.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, pairing over 94 TB of integrated mechanical storage directly with 32 dedicated cores yields high storage density per compute instance without requiring separate network-attached block volumes. This hardware distribution aligns directly with distributed file systems, Apache Hadoop clusters, HDFS data node deployments, log processing pipelines, and sequential ETL analytics.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a big data virtual server featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors and 128.0 GB of system memory. Operating on KVM virtualization within an x86_64 environment, it delivers a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory allocation alongside a 20 Gbps baseline network throughput. The defining physical asset of this instance is its bundled 94,489 GB of local HDD storage, which provides vast on-host storage capacity without graphics acceleration hardware. While rotational disks yield lower random I/O rates compared to NVMe SSD arrays, they maximize cost efficiency for bulk storage footprints. Consequently, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge serves large-scale distributed analytics, Hadoop and Spark clusters, HDFS nodes, large log aggregation systems, and high-throughput batch ETL processing.
